paragraphs.text: The Omenpath Arc is the one-year storyline that deals with the aftermath of the New Phyrexian Invasion , the consequences of the Desparkening , the opening of the Omenpaths , and a new character named Kellan . It comprises of the premier sets Wilds of Eldraine , The Lost Caverns of Ixalan , Murders at Karlov Manor , and Outlaws of Thunder Junction .
It is the first part of a three-year story arc codenamed Metronome . Metronome is Magic's fourth modern major story arc after the Eldrazi Arc , the Bolas Arc , and the Phyrexian Arc .

Following up on the conclusion of the Phyrexian Arc , the Omenpath Arc started in September 2023 and features the following sets: Wilds of Eldraine , The Lost Caverns of Ixalan , Murders at Karlov Manor , Outlaws of Thunder Junction and The Big Score . While not containing story elements, Alchemy: Eldraine , Alchemy: Ixalan , Alchemy: Karlov Manor and Alchemy: Thunder Junction are set within the Omenpath Arc.

The story follows Kellan - the non- planeswalker , half- fae , and half- human son of Oko - as he travels across Eldraine , Ixalan , Ravnica , and Thunder Junction in search of his father via Omenpaths. As such, he appears once in every set in this arc. The arc also secretly features Jace Beleren - masquerading as Ashiok - and Vraska , as they begin their plot to recreate the multiverse using the Coin Empire 's technology and other remnants . In-universe, the arc takes place over roughly a year and a half.
The storyline of Metronome is continued in the Dragonstorm Arc .
